TC-12/S05.title: 12 h expiry in both modes: present before 12 h, deleted by the server after, not restarted by Save Note, editor open/close, edit
TC-12/S05.detail: Points written 11 h 57 min ago by server time (a new card keeps a past createdAt in stampImportantPointEdits; no clock changed, no internal call). Before 12 h all 12 charts stored + shown; after 12 h + one sweep (the 1-minute cron, server side) all deleted on the server and gone from the editor, including the chart nobody opened (H3), after Save Note (H2/N2), editor open/close (H5/N4) and an edit (H8/N8, which kept the original createdAt); a point added minutes before kept (H4/N3); an editor left open across the expiry dropped the card live and Save Note + a new point from it did not write it back (H7); a stale client re-sending the expired card with its clock is refused. Prior-note import at 11 h (H6) not run here: S15 shows import leaves id and createdAt unchanged. Recorded (ours): the unsaved draft (importantPointsDraft) is NOT cleared at 12 h; a client re-sending the expired card WITHOUT createdAt gets it back with a fresh 12 h. Judged checks 44/44.
